defects_found_and_fixed.finding: Two different SHAs were published for the freeze branch. Resolved mechanically: the stale value was a superseded parent commit, not a parallel branch.

The freeze script hashed raw working-tree bytes. Windows checkout rewrites these files to CRLF, so the published sha256 only reproduced on Windows and would have read as tampering to a Linux or macOS auditor.
